notes.title: Cuboid Bouncer - Major Update
notes.content:
- Cuboid Bouncer now has the ability to save at each level.
- Signs placed at the end of each level indicating completion of level.
- Fixed a few glitches where when losing, the "You Lose!" message appears several times.

notes.title: Cuboid Bouncer - Patch Notes 24 June 2021
notes.content: Fixed glitch where if you lose with one second left in Level 12, you lose and win at the same time.
